employeeId: # hr_feed.csv  --  Mock HR roster for Contoso Health (contosohealth.io)
# This file stands in for a Workday / SAP SuccessFactors worker export. In
# production the HR system of record feeds the same Entra provisioning
# service (Workday/SuccessFactors via Entra's native connectors
# any other HRIS via this API-driven endpoint). The downstream automation
# does not change.
# COLUMN CONTRACT (consumed by Invoke-InboundProvisioning.ps1 and 02/03/04-*.ps1)
#   employeeId  numeric worker id. Maps to SCIM externalId AND
#               enterprise extension employeeNumber. Also the join key the
#               'manager' column points at (manager-by-employeeId resolution).
#   givenName   first name  -> SCIM name.givenName
#   surname     last name   -> SCIM name.familyName
#   dept        department  -> enterprise extension 'department'
#   jobTitle    title       -> SCIM title
#   manager     employeeId of this worker's manager (blank = top of chain)
#   status      joiner | active | leaver  (lifecycle state -- see note below)
#   startDate   ISO-8601 hire / effective date (YYYY-MM-DD)
#   endDate     ISO-8601 termination date for leavers
# LIFECYCLE STATUS SEMANTICS
#   joiner  pre-hire / day-1 worker. SCIM active=true; onboarding runs.
#   active  steady-state worker. A "MOVER" is an *active* row whose dept or
#           jobTitle differs from what the directory currently holds -- there
#           is intentionally no 'mover' status; movers are detected by diffing
#           this feed against Entra (see 03-Mover.ps1 and this folder's README).
#   leaver  terminated worker. SCIM active=false; offboarding runs (04-Leaver).
# NOTE: lines beginning with '#' are comments stripped by Invoke-InboundProvisioning.ps1
#       before parsing. Keep the header row (line 1) first and uncommented.
# PROTAGONIST: Dana Okafor (employeeId 100492) -- the worker the video follows
#              from hire (segment 2) to departure (segment 7). Shipped as a
#              'joiner' so the segment-2 onboarding demo runs against her.
# MOVER:       Marcus Bello (employeeId 100310) ships in Nursing. The mover demo
#              edits his dept to ICU here
#              (-StatusFilter active)
# LEAVER:      the leaver demo flips Dana's status to 'leaver' + sets endDate.
# IT / IAM:    Ava Lin (IAM engineer)
#              Mei Tanaka (access governance lead) work in Information
#              Technology under Joan Ferris. Their WORKFORCE accounts here get
#              no privileged birthright; admin work uses separate cloud-only
#              adm- accounts (lab/iga/admin-accounts.json
#              post-apply/New-AdminAccounts.ps1) that are only ever PIM-eligible.
